title: fix(metadata)!: the boot priming pass leaves a package-less stored row of a type stored per (package, name) unstamped, so the host's package is never counted as a holder of its name (ADR-0150 D4)
body:
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuPZqZKjS27xLe5AvdTBhiyo)_ Fixes #32812 domain:server#7 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVHhRMN8oWxaL4Ph3X (card thread; claim 6840443478). Branch: platform-assigned `claude/project-thread-y90728`. Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — one face widens against the last release and the others narrow, all on a host that declares its package and wires a `DatabaseLoader`; the widening is named under the BREAKING banner below. Adds one method to the exported `MetadataManager`, `sourceLoaderProtocolOf(item)` (the protocol of the loader `loadMany` read an item from), which the pass asks. Narrows: on a host that declares its package (`MetadataPlugin`'s `packageId`) and wires a `DatabaseLoader` (or another loader of the `datasource:` protocol), a package-less stored row of `api`, `agent`, `skill`, `action`, `email_template`, `permission`, `flow`, `picklist`, `mapping` or `dataset` is no longer served as the host package's item after the boot priming pass: its body no longer carries `_packageId` set to the host's package or `_provenance: 'package'`, the metadata list filtered by the host's package (`?package=` naming it) no longer lists it, and `publishPackage`, `revertPackage` and `unregisterPackage` naming the host's package no longer take it as one of that package's items (where the host's package itself holds the name, the row is that package's customization, ADR-0150 D4, and goes with its slot as for any holder). The `409` this lifts (the bare read naming the host's package, which holds nothing, after a write that carries no package) is #32560's, which has not shipped. Metadata-protocol: none — no key, value or metadata type an author writes changes; what moves is which package the boot pass gives a stored row that names none. Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` do not teach that the boot pass gives a stored row the host's package; the migration step ships in the changeset note and is carried into the release's upgrade notes when they are written. Ruling-ref: the epic #31527 seat ruled the `Clause-②:` value `yes (narrowing)` for this head's line: one face widens against the last release and the others narrow, and red line 1 requires the widening to be declared; the BREAKING text names it as a behaviour change for the ADR-0150 D4 reason (the answer a host that declares no package gives). DELIBERATE CORRECTION (declared in 6844273668, accepted by the seat in its r2 handoff 6844957321): this PR rewrites two pending notes its change made false, `.changeset/32791-stored-row-one-holder-bare-action-read.md` (title, the stamping paragraph, the filing paragraph, the after-the-pass table row, two clauses of the Unchanged list, the Scope paragraph) and one sentence of `.changeset/32986-host-unregister-keeps-environment-rows.md` (the boot pass stamps only rows of types not stored per `(package, name)`). `Check Changeset` is red on those two files by design; the corrected sentences are quoted in 6844273668. ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：宿主声明了自己的包时，启动预载不再给十个按包类型（api、agent、skill、action、email_template、permission、flow、picklist、mapping、dataset）里不带包的库行盖宿主包戳。这类行按 D4 是环境自己的项或唯一持有包的定制，从来不属于宿主包。库行靠加载器的 `datasource:` 协议识别（新增公开方法 `MetadataManager.sourceLoaderProtocolOf`），不看加载器名字。#32802 在读时补救盖戳造成的重复计数，这套补救随之删除。 - 为什么改：#32802 只修了启动后的状态；一次不带包的写入（`register` 或 `registerInMemory`）之后，裸读又 409 点名并不存在的持有者 `com.host.app`（专题 #31527 红线 2）。不盖戳后幽灵持有者根本不会形成，裸读与裸删除重新数同一批持有者，所有答案都与「宿主不声明包」时同一格一致。 - 风险与回滚：BREAKING（`!`）：宿主声明包且接了库行加载器时，这些环境行不再带宿主的 `_packageId`/`_provenance`，`?package=宿主` 的列表、`publishPackage`/`revertPackage`/`unregisterPackage(宿主)` 不再把它们当宿主包的成员；唯一放宽的一面见 changeset 的 BREAKING 段（与宿主不声明包时同答）。第一方没有宿主同时声明包又接 `DatabaseLoader`。18.3.0 曾把戳写进行体的存量行不受影响（另立卡）。其他类型与宿主自己的文件项照旧盖戳。回滚即 revert。 - 先看：`packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts` 的 `unstampedStoredRow` 与 `_loadFromFileSystem` 里的 `applyProtection` 调用；`metadata-manager.ts` 是 `25ee5076^` 加上 #32986（随 #32999 合入）的非按包部分和 `sourceLoaderProtocolOf`，`package-slotted-store.ts` 逐字节还原到 `25ee5076^`。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts`，应见 284 passed（在 main 的三个源文件下 21 个红：卡表两行、裸删除一致、九类写后读、email_template、M1 别名加载器、S1 两条，加 13 个声明移动的旧钉）。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 ## What changes On a host that declares its package, the boot priming pass (`MetadataPlugin._loadFromFileSystem`) stamped every item it registered with the host's package (`applyProtection`), the package-less rows `DatabaseLoader` hands out included, except (#32521) a row of a name two packages hold. The registry then held such a row in the host's slot while the loaders still stored it package-less. Since #32560 the bare `action` read is judged over the registry's slots and the loaders' together, so the row was counted as the host's package and as the environment. #32802 corrected the count right after the pass with a read-time filing of the stamped row; after any write that carries no package the registry's slot was a plain item again and the host was named once more (this card, finding S2 of #32802's review 6835430791). **The fix (design B, step 0 measured it against A; epic seat ruling on the scope).** 1. **`plugin.ts`: `unstampedStoredRow`.** The pass keeps the host's package off a package-less stored row (no package on its column or body) of a type in `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`, handed out by a loader whose contract declares the stored-row protocol `datasource:`. The protocol is read through one new public method, `MetadataManager.sourceLoaderProtocolOf(item)` (the protocol of the loader `loadMany` read the item from), so a stored-row loader registered under another name than `DatabaseLoader`'s is treated the same (triage r1 M1). The store files the row where it files any write that carries no package (the name's one holder's customization, else the name's bare slot). The host's own file items and every other type's items are stamped as before. This subsumes #32521's `contestedNames` (a subset of these rows), which is removed; `primingOrder` is kept. 2. **`metadata-manager.ts` and `package-slotted-store.ts`.** #32802's filing (`storedPackagelessRows`, `storedRowsOverOwnItems` with its mark and carry, the `asStored` branch of `slotViewOf` with its `aliases`, `inheritStoreWriteOrder`'s `aliases`, `packagelessWriteKeyOf`) has nothing left to file: step 0 ablated each piece with B applied and none moved a test or one of 2082 probe cells. Both files are `25ee5076^`'s, except that `metadata-manager.ts` keeps #32986's `storedEnvironmentRows`, `isStampedEnvironmentRow` and the non-slotted `datasource:` branch of `loadMany` (merged with #32999; only its slotted branch, the filing's, is dropped) and adds `sourceLoaderProtocolOf`. Every #32791 pin marked CONTROL passes unchanged. Scope: B-slotted, not every type. The epic seat's ruling made B-all conditional on no reader depending on the host's stamp for the other types; that premise does not hold (`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` registers an object read from the metadata service under its `_packageId`, else `metadata-service`), so the other types are unchanged here (and #32986 keeps their environment rows on `unregisterPackage` of the host). ### Moved answers (FROM `main` `25ee5076` → TO this head) Rows of `helper` in `sys_metadata`, one `DatabaseLoader`, the real boot pass, ALPHA = `com.alpha.app`, host = `com.host.app` unless stated. Every TO is the answer the same composition gives on a host that declares no package (step 0: 0 cells on a declaring host differ from host none in sections A and B, against 93 and 121 on `main`). | Composition | Read | FROM | TO | |:--|:--|:--|:--| | ALPHA's row, package-less row saved last; then `register` with no package | bare `get`, `getDiagnosed` (`action`) | `409` host, ALPHA, environment | the written body | | the same; then `registerInMemory` of a package-less item | bare `get`, `getDiagnosed` (`action`) | `409` host, ALPHA, environment | the item | | the same, right after the pass | removal naming no package (`action`) | `409` host, ALPHA, environment | removes the package-less row; the bare read then answers ALPHA's row | | the same, after the `register` | removal naming no package (`action`) | `409` host, ALPHA, environment | removes the package-less row; the bare read answers ALPHA's row, which holds the written body | | the same, right after the pass, each of the ten types | registry key | the host's slot | the bare slot (`email_template`: the holder's slot) | | the same, each of the nine unbundled types | read naming ALPHA | ALPHA's own row | the package-less row (its customization) | | the same, host ALPHA, each of the nine unbundled types | read naming `com.host.app` (holds nothing) | nothing | the package-less row, as the bare read | | the same, through a stored-row loader that declares `datasource:` under another name | bare read, then after a `register` | the package-less row (#32791's filing), then `409` naming the host; at this PR's name-keyed first head `409` right after the pass too | the package-less row, then the written body | | package-less row, ALPHA's `action` item registered in memory after the pass | bare `get`, `getDiagnosed` | the package-less row | ALPHA's item (the by-host difference #32752 tracked) | | a package's item registered in memory beside the package-less row (`email_template`: one package's row beside it) | read naming `com.host.app` | the package-less row | nothing: the host's package holds nothing there | | ALPHA's row, package-less row saved last, the row deleted from the table behind the manager | bare `get`, `getDiagnosed` (`action`) | `409` host, ALPHA | the registry's copy | | ALPHA's row and a package-less row, `email_template` | bare read after the pass | `409` naming the host | as on a host that declares none | | a package-less row of one of the ten types beside ALPHA's | its body; `list`; `?package=` host list; `publishPackage`/`revertPackage`/`unregisterPackage` naming the host | stamped with the host's package and `_provenance: 'package'`; listed twice; taken as the host package's | unstamped; listed once, package-less; not the host package's (the Clause-② narrowing arm) | | the same composition, every one of the ten types | removal naming no package | `409` naming the host's package | removes the package-less row (`email_template`: the holder's slot) | | the same, a read naming a package that holds nothing (the host's own on a host declaring the holder's; a third package on a host declaring another) | read naming that package | nothing | the package-less row, as the bare read | | a package-less `action` row alone, removed with no package | bare read, `list`, registry keys | the registry's stamped copy (until a restart) | nothing | | a caller of the public `loadMany` that stamps a package-less row itself and registers it | bare read right after | the package-less row (#32791's filing) | `409` naming that package beside the holder, as after any write | | a package-less row of these types on a host whose own package is disabled | served | hidden | no longer hidden, as on a host that declares no package (the one widening, per the ruling above) | Unchanged: every composition with two holders is refused as on `main`, on one pass and on two (the #32791 CONTROLs: epic ruling B's six cells, r1's S1(c) cell, review S3's three two-pass cases, review B2's cells); the host's own file items; every other type, including #32986's environment rows kept by `unregisterPackage` of the host; a host that declares no package. ## Why ADR-0150 D4: a package-less row bearing a package-held name is that package's customization, never a second item; a row of a name no package holds is the environment's own item. Neither is the host package's. Stamping it so made the host a holder of a name it does not hold (red line 2), first counted away at read time by #32802 and named again after one write. Leaving the row unstamped removes the cause, so no read-time correction is needed after a write, a removal or a second pass. ## Tests `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts`, inside the `[#32791]` describe (its header now covers #32812): - New (red on `main`): `email_template`'s composition (the holder's slot on both hosts); the card's two rows (`register` with no package; `registerInMemory` of a package-less item; each then `get` and `getDiagnosed`); the removal naming no package agreeing with the bare read right after the pass and after a `register`, on a host declaring another package and on one declaring none (#32813's subject in this composition); every unbundled type, the card's composition and a `register` with no package, the bare read answering the written body on both hosts (CONTROL for the eight types other than `action`); the card's composition through a stored-row loader whose contract is named `tenant-rows` (M1); the served row carrying no stamp, `list` naming it once, and `publishPackage` / `unregisterPackage` naming the host leaving it, as on a host declaring none (S1); a lone package-less `action` row removed with no package, after which the bare read, `list` and the registry answer nothing (S1). - Moved (13, each comment names FROM `main` `25ee5076` and the TO): four #32791 pins (one package's row and a package-less row: the registry key and the read naming the holder; the object-bound shape: the registry key; one package's item registered in memory after the pass, plus a host-none cell beside it; the row deleted behind the manager, now measured on both hosts) and the nine `[#32521] CONTROL … one package's row and a package-less row` cells, whose host-ALPHA and host-`com.host.app` rows now equal the host-none row. - Not pinned in this package: the disabled-package widening. Whether a disabled package's items are hidden is read by `@objectstack/core` and `@objectstack/runtime` from the stamp, not by `@objectstack/metadata`; the row it reaches is the S1 pin's unstamped row. A pin beside that reader in `@objectstack/runtime` is follow-up #33035 (triage r2 S4). - Unchanged and green: every #32791 CONTROL (epic ruling B's cells on one and two passes, cache kept and dropped; S1(c); B2; S3; every by-package type; the host's own item in memory), every `[#31699]`, `[#32458]` and `[#32521]` pin, and #32986's pins merged from `main`.
Red before the fix This head's test file (284 tests) over `main` `994c7d67`'s `plugin.ts`, `metadata-manager.ts` and `package-slotted-store.ts` (restored after with `git restore --source=HEAD --staged --worktree`; each blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty): **21 failed** | 263 passed (284). The 21 are the eight new pins and the 13 moved ones; every CONTROL not declared moved passes, #32986's pins included. The two card rows answer `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `ambiguous-in-environment`, candidates `com.host.app`, `com.alpha.app`, `environment`, as the card's table says. The first four were run at `571346fc` (275 tests), the fifth at `317349ae`; each edits the one line of `unstampedStoredRow`. The predicate is unchanged since `317349ae`; the later commits add no code to it. | Mutation (marker) | Result | |:--|:--| | the row is stamped again (`ABL_32812_STAMP`, the predicate always false) | 48 failed: 12 `[#32791]` pins (the four new ones, the four moved ones, and four #32791 pins #32802's filing held, one a CONTROL: two packages' rows and a package-less row) and 36 `[#32521]` pins (the nine moved CONTROLs and the 27 two-holder cells `contestedNames` held). Without the filing nothing corrects the count | | `action` only (`ABL_32812_ACTION`) | 32 failed: the eight non-`action` `[#32521]` CONTROLs and the 24 non-`action` two-holder cells | | any loader, not only a stored-row one (`ABL_32812_LOADER`) | 20 failed: the host's own file items lose their stamp (two `[#31699 R5-A]` pins, the file-system seeding CONTROL and `[#32488 R7-C]`, and the 18 `[#32521]` host's-own-file cells) | | a row whose body or column names a package is unstamped too (`ABL_32812_PKG`) | 1 failed: `[R7-A]` (a legacy row's empty column bound from its stamped body) | | no protocol check, any loader's package-less item (`ABL_32812_PROTOCOL`, at `317349ae`, 279 tests) | 20 failed: the host's own file items lose their stamp (the file-system seeding CONTROL, `[#32488 R7-C]` and the 18 `[#32521]` host's-own-file cells). The M1 pin is red on the name-keyed first head `ec483d4f` instead (see Red before the fix) |
## Acceptance notes - **Scope (epic seat ruling).** B-all was conditional on no reader depending on the host's stamp for the other types (`object`, `view`, `app`, `hook`, `dashboard`). It does not hold: `ObjectQLPlugin` registers an object it reads from the metadata service under that body's `_packageId`, else `metadata-service`. Those types are unchanged here; their `unregisterPackage` naming the host is #32986's (merged). - **Rows an earlier release's boot pass wrote the stamp into.** 18.3.0's pass wrote the host's stamp into stored bodies; `main` binds such a row's column from its body on first read, so it reads as the host package's under every design. Not changed here; the seat's separate card under #32791. - **#32813.** In the card's composition the removal naming no package now names the holders the bare read names (step 0, section B: 25 disagreements on `main`, 0 here). Pinned above; the seat tells #32813. - **#32752.** Its by-host difference (a package-less row, a package's item registered in memory after the pass) is gone: every host answers that package's item, as a host declaring no package or that package did. This reverses #32802's declared row-5 TO for a host declaring another package. - **What #32802's filing still covered** (declared in the table and the changeset). A caller of the public `loadMany` that stamps the rows itself and registers them (a re-implementation of the old pass): its bare read right after registering is refused naming the host, as on `main` before #32802 and on `main` after any write. No first-party caller does this (`applyProtection` is called on loader rows only in `plugin.ts`). - **Readers of the stamp** move with it (the changeset's list is not complete; each reads the row as a host declaring no package does): a `protection` block's lock source, the MCP face's name, the boot pass's realtime events. - **Candidate order** in a refusal is not promised (changeset). - First-party reach 0: no package, app or example declares a package and wires a `DatabaseLoader`. - The commit `7a3dbecc`'s `Claude-Session` trailer names the seat's session, not this card thread's; it is pushed history and is not rewritten. - `pr_request_reviewers` is the seat's step at hand-off. ## Verification At head `f61e8ab1` (`main` `994c7d67` merged once after #32999, conflict in `metadata-manager.ts` resolved as above): - `pnpm turbo run build`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata typecheck`: exit 0. `npx vitest run` in `packages/metadata`: 76 files, **2097 passed** (2097).
